_comment: Checked list of integration test files that stay Unix-only for #521. Each entry names the Unix-only mechanism that still blocks a Windows port (usually /bin/sh or printf/sleep applets with no Windows binary, real signal delivery, PTYs, Unix sockets, or unix file metadata). Converted files are removed from this list. tools/test_unix_only_tests.py refuses any #![cfg(...unix...)] test file that is not listed here.
adversarial.rs: shell applets plus symlink/permission unix metadata assertions
applet_executable_pinning.rs: shell applets plus symlink confinement and PATH executable-bit assertions
cache_dependencies.rs: shell applets with chmod executable bit
cache_security.rs: shell applets plus symlink and fcntl file-flag assertions
child_env_minimize.rs: runs /usr/bin/env applet and asserts daemon env scoping
cli.rs: drives printf/pwd/cd applets from the bundled registry through the CLI
conditions.rs: runs printf/false applets for branch coverage
cpu.rs: shell ps fixture with chmod executable bit for screens ranking
daemon_cli.rs: UnixListener/UnixStream daemon socket plus unix process/file metadata
demo_walkthrough.rs: fake compositor is a shell script launched via sh
direct_commands.rs: symlinked printf applet plus shell-looking argv cases
fs_deadlines.rs: POSIX mkfifo utility plus unix file-type assertions
graph_composition_acceptance.rs: python3 harness applets for composed graphs
inspection.rs: runs printf applets for inspect/effect coverage
invocation_io.rs: runs sh and printf applets for stdio capture
ladder.rs: python3 child plus real SIGTERM delivery via libc::kill
lane_a_cli.rs: runs loop/glob programs through shell-tool applets
lane_a_demo.rs: fake demo tool is a shell script with chmod executable bit
lane_b_drain_signals.rs: real SIGINT delivery to a running program
lane_o_double_interrupt_cleanup.rs: real PTY Ctrl-C with SIGINT process-group semantics
lane_o_init.rs: real SIGTERM forwarding to the worker
lane_o_terminal.rs: needs a Linux controlling PTY for terminal handoff
live.rs: opt-in live control plane over unix-domain sockets with python3 driver
loops.rs: runs printf/tr/cat/true/false loop applets with no Windows binary
manifest_catalog_cli.rs: packed-catalog parity runs PATH printf plus live.sock serve cases
manifest_trust.rs: symlink/permission/setuid trust assertions with shell applets
model_cli.rs: runs printf applets for model CLI coverage
model_control.rs: real SIGTERM delivery to model children
model_workflows.rs: process-group SIGTERM via python3 model workers
native_status.rs: runs sh -c kill -TERM applets for status mapping
opt_child_wakeup.rs: shell applets with chmod executable bit
opt_diagnostics_poll.rs: python3 worker plus signal-0 liveness probes
opt_local_child_observer.rs: signal-0 child liveness probes on shell workers
opt_services_checkpoint_listener.rs: checkpointed listener runs PATH printf applets
opt_small_input.rs: PIPE_BUF-sized stdin prods with shell applets
opt_stdin_prefill.rs: PIPE_BUF/rusage stdin prefill with shell applets
process_inputs.rs: shebang execute applets plus OsStringExt argv bytes
program_inputs.rs: runs printf/cat/head applets for program input coverage
program_module_accounting.rs: shell polling applets with chmod executable bit
resume.rs: real SIGTERM kill mid-checkpoint plus shell applets
security_dataflow_runtime.rs: shell dataflow applets with unix permission gates
security_redaction.rs: manifests with /bin/sh binary for redaction cases
service_environment.rs: manifests with /bin/sh binary for environment cases
staged_helpers.rs: asserts unix nlink/uid/mode single-link executable contract
stdin.rs: real SIGTERM plus fcntl stdin-deadline assertions
terminal_output_escape.rs: real pty slave fd for TTY escape rendering
timeout.rs: python3 worker plus signal-0 timeout probes
typed_contracts.rs: shell applets plus unix directory-mode assertions
ui.rs: screens CLI fixtures with chmod executable bit
